import z3, itertools, time
n=25
opt=z3.Solver()
# opt.set('timeout', 55000)
x={}
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1,n):
        x[i,j]=z3.Bool(f'e_{i}_{j}')
# degrees 3..7
for i in range(n):
    inc=[x[min(i,j),max(i,j)] for j in range(n) if j!=i]
    opt.add(z3.PbGe([(v,1) for v in inc], 3))
    opt.add(z3.PbLe([(v,1) for v in inc], 7))
# no cycles length 3-6
cnt=0
for k in range(3,7):
    # enumerate each undirected cycle once: choose subset and permutations fixing min first and second < last
    for subset in itertools.combinations(range(n), k):
        m=min(subset)
        rest=[v for v in subset if v!=m]
        for perm in itertools.permutations(rest):
            cyc=(m,)+perm
            if cyc[1] > cyc[-1]:
                continue
            lits=[]
            for a,b in zip(cyc, cyc[1:]+(cyc[0],)):
                if a>b: a,b=b,a
                lits.append(x[a,b])
            opt.add(z3.Not(z3.And(lits)))
            cnt+=1
print('constraints cycles',cnt)
t=time.time(); res=opt.check(); print('res',res,'time',time.time()-t)
if res==z3.sat:
    model=opt.model()
    edges=[(i,j) for (i,j),v in x.items() if z3.is_true(model.eval(v))]
    print('m',len(edges)); print(edges)
    deg=[0]*n
    for i,j in edges: deg[i]+=1; deg[j]+=1
    print(deg)
